newsitem.title: USA: Dividend hikes decline in third quarter - Barron's.
newsitem.headline: Dividend hikes decline in third quarter - Barron's.

text.p: Third quarter corporate dividend increases slowed by 4.5 percent over a year ago, resulting in the first three month downturn since the first quarter of 1995, according to an article in Barron's.
However, the 1,556 boosts declared for the year to date were still 10.4 percent better than the comparable 1995 showing of 1,410, the newspaper said.

Barron's also said bonus dividends continue to be popular with companies, since they let firms reward investors without committing themselves to a sustained rate they may not be able to support down the road.
